lines.1: 「This place isn't as rough as I expected.」
lines.2: 「At night the bars open and the place comes alive. They hold shows in the basements too.」
lines.4: 「Oh, there's even a store that sells cosmetics here.」
lines.5: 「Yeah, I hear that shop's pretty good.」
lines.6: 「At first, girls in my class kept saying, 'Cosmetics are cheap here, and they have a great selection,' and I didn't even know what they meant by 'cosmetics.'」
lines.7: 「The foundation really is about ten percent cheaper. The lip gloss too...」
lines.9: 「Lip balm's about as far as I go.」
lines.12: 「Well, maybe you don't need to wear any...」
lines.13: I looked over and saw Konoe holding some concealer too.
lines.15: 「Yes, I do. You need it when your skin acts up.」
lines.16: 「I know this one. It's that thing you use on your eyes.」
lines.18: 「Look, now the other customers are laughing at us!」
lines.20: Crab almost never went to places like this, so I got a little overexcited by the novelty.
lines.21: Man... makeup sure is a hassle.
lines.22: I was glad I was born a guy.
lines.26: 「Used books run a little cheaper around here too.」
lines.27: 「They're independent shops, not big chains. They don't care about the going rate.」
lines.28: 「Do you read manga? I can't really picture it.」
lines.29: 「For newer stuff, I read NANYA like anyone else.」
lines.31: 「Romance stories like that really are fun.」
lines.34: 「So what goes through your head when you read it?」
lines.35: 「I wonder who'll end up with who, or think, 'This situation is so romantic,' or, 'Yas-san is such a great guy.' That sort of thing.」
lines.36: 「That's normal too... I thought you'd pick apart every situation, going, 'That would never happen,' and tear it to shreds.」
lines.39: 「Oh--no, sorry! I just made that up because I was expecting you to snap back!」
lines.41: 「There we go. That's more like it.」
lines.43: I hadn't expected that to hurt her feelings...
lines.44: 「Okay, I get that you like romance stories.」
lines.46: 「Isn't it kind of childish? You beat a strong guy, then an even stronger one just shows up, right? I do like the part where they work hard to beat them, though.」
lines.50: 「On my honor as a manga fan, I'm going to brainwash you.」
lines.52: 「This one, this one, and this one are on me. Read them and tell me what you think.」
lines.54: 「They'll just weigh you down, so I'll carry them until the end of the day.」
lines.57: 「Fine. If you feel that strongly, I'll read them.」
lines.58: Going around all those shops taught us a lot about each other's tastes.
lines.59: What surprised me was that Konoe had what you'd call pretty ordinary tastes for a girl.
lines.60: I'd thought she was weirdly serious, but now I realized she was just a normal girl too.
